normalNewProfile.summary: Play a new campaign with the normal EXE, save and exit; attach its launch report and resulting profile.

normalMigratedProfile.summary: Use the normal EXE with a copied old profile; verify settings/statistics survive migration, then exit; attach before/after and launch report.

normalCampaignContinue.summary: Restart the normal EXE with saved campaign, continue the checkpoint, verify progress/resources and exit; attach both real sessions.

physicalController.summary: Actual controller: menus, focus, remapping, combat, unplug/reconnect; name hardware and observations.

otherWindows.summary: Run this exact ZIP on another clean Windows installation; record hardware, OS, bundled JVM, audio and normal exit.

ownerFeel.summary: Owner's actual review of handling, UI, visuals and sound of this package.

graphicalUxMatrix.summary: Actual window/resolution/UI/input matrix from RELEASE_PLAN, linked screenshots and resolved defects.

arenaRoutes.summary: All six maps: actual lower/launch/upper/pickup/drop routes and boss combat at both levels where applicable.

distributionLicenses.summary: Review shipped notices and source/replacement obligations, including the packaged OpenAL Soft binaries.

releaseDocumentation.summary: Installation, controls, release notes, known limitations, tested hardware, resource register and acceptance report are complete.
